name: Vi
description: Voice set for Debonair Vi (skin 3): an immaculate, composed woman in charge of herself and her destiny, in a power tie and rose boutonniere, polite about it right up until she breaks something. Lounges, deals, tables, tabs and velvet menace. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. Unacceptable. Someone's about to be renegotiated.
Thirty or more behind. Call every associate you've got. I'll hold the door.
{momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind. Have a word with a few friends. Politely, then less so.
Fifteen-odd votes short. A rounding error with a good lawyer.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring in a few associates. Smile when you ask.
{voteDiff} behind. A few firm handshakes and we're level.
Down {voteDiff}. Trivial. Close it before the drinks arrive.
Dead level. One vote sways the whole table. Cast it.
One vote apart. Don't just stir your drink, make a move.
{voteDiff} votes between them. A delicate negotiation. Bring more voices.
{voteDiff} votes apart. We'll be here until last call.
{momentTitle} sits at {userPct}%. A well-tailored lead.
{userPct}% and still pressing. Never loosen the tie.
{userPct}%. Handsome lead. Don't gloat. Yet.
{userPct}% on your pick. We hold the table. Keep it that way.
Up at {userPct}%. Splendid. Now close the deal.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. A hostile takeover. I do enjoy those.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. The late arrivals knew exactly what to say.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} hole in a spotless suit. Style.
{momentTitle} was losing. A temporary arrangement.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. As planned. Mostly.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. We share excellent taste.
{username} picked {momentTitle} too. A kindred spirit at the table.
{username} agrees with you. A pleasant rarity.
Same pick as {username}. An alliance, then.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Discerning.
{username} chose the same. Pour them a drink.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Keep them in the circle.
{username} made the same call. No negotiation needed.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. A fine associate.
details: Add them to the guest list.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. A rash decision.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Let's see who wins the room.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but at least it's bold.
{username} voted against you. I'd comment, but the numbers are more eloquent.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Brazen. Foolish, but brazen.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Splendid. I do love a competitor.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. We'll let the tally arbitrate.
{username} voted the other way. They'll be asking for terms soon.
details: Everyone misjudges a deal now and then.
Don't take it personally. Or do, tastefully.
They'll come round. They always do.
At least it's a civilised fight.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck, that's a partnership of equals.
{username} and you, ten matches, same position every time. A formidable pairing.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd sign that merger.
A ten-match run with {username}. Elegantly done.
Ten for ten with {username}. I'm impressed. Don't let it get around.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's beyond partnership, that's an empire.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd back the two of you in any boardroom.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Scandalous. In the best way.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. They'll write profiles about you.
{streakCount} with {username}. Consider the whole establishment yours.
details: I have no remarks. Only admiration.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A proper feud has begun.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. They dislike your taste intensely.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will concede the table.
A ten-match run against {username}. Obstinate, the pair of you.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd pay for a seat at that dinner.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a dynasty of spite.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives an inch of the carpet.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. Obstinate barely covers it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone fetch a mediator. And wine.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Do take up a hobby.
details: Neither of you is backing down.
Glad I'm not seated between you.

messages: {matchTitle} concludes in {timeLeft} and you haven't made an offer. Do join us.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your position isn't on the table. Fix that.
{matchTitle} wraps in {timeLeft}. Yours is the one voice missing.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Do hurry.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me send someone to collect you.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. We're still waiting on you.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Last call, darling.
{timeLeft} left. Decide. Elegantly.
Final offer on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Make it count.
{matchCount} matches without your vote are about to close. The first concludes in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches nearing last call. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody open the bidding.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a single voice. I'll wait. Elegantly. Briefly.
New match, empty table. Be the first to sit.
{matchTitle} is wide open. Make the opening offer.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A sparse guest list.
Hardly anyone's voted here. Remedy that.
Turnout's poor. Do liven the room.
Nobody's weighed in on this one. Someone ought to.
details: In a quiet room, every voice carries.

messages: {matchTitle} is deadlocked and your vote is absent. Settle it.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote tips the table.
Tied. Someone must make the decisive move. Make it you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked at the table. Choose.
Still tied and nearly out of time. Last chance to settle it.
Level with the evening nearly over. Vote.
Tied, with the hour late. Don't sit this dance out.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches. Shall we begin?
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. Take your seats.
Round {round} is live, {matchCount} negotiations deep.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Choose your allies.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your word.
{momentTitle} won. Deal sealed.
{momentTitle} is through. Fine instincts.
{momentTitle} took it. Immaculate.
{momentTitle} won, and with perfect composure.
{momentTitle} advances. Without a hair out of place.
{momentTitle} moves on. That's how it's done in good company.
details: That's a win on the books.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. That's regrettable.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the terms I'd hoped for.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Compose yourself.
{momentTitle} fell with grace. Admirable.
{momentTitle} is out. Straighten the tie and move on.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A minor setback. We negotiate again.
{momentTitle} was shown out. We return for the next.
details: Take the loss. Keep your composure.

messages: Still weighing it? Don't dither. Choose.
Don't overthink it. Choose with style and move on.
They're all worth a look. Trust your taste.
You've considered long enough. Choose.
details: No wrong way to choose. Some less elegant than others.

messages: Welcome. {liveCount} matches are open. Choose one.
New to the establishment? {liveCount} matches are live. Come in.
Perfect timing. {liveCount} matches need votes.
{liveCount} matches open. Take a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Impress me.
Day two. You returned. Splendid.
Two days running. Charming.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days gone. How kind of you to drop in.
After {days} days you're back. Fashionably late.
{days} days. I assumed you'd left town. Delighted you didn't.
{days} days away. A great deal to catch up on.
You're back. Delightful.
Welcome back. Shall we?
Back already. Charming.
Hello again. The tables are waiting.
First vote in. Welcome to the table.
You picked a side. A confident opening.
details: Now do it again, with flair. +{xp} XP
The first round's on me. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You're settling in nicely.
Five. You've found your seat.
Ten votes. The staff know your name.
Ten. You've a standing reservation now.
Twenty-five votes. A voice the room turns toward.
Twenty-five. Conversations stop when you speak.
details: Twenty-five on the guest book. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes. You're thick in the plot.
Fifty. You truly care. How refreshing.
A hundred votes. Legends are made of less.
One hundred. Frankly impressive. Do carry on.
details: Earned with grace and grit. +{xp} XP
A hundred. Take a long, slow bow. +{xp} XP

messages: Three evenings running. A habit, darling.
Three straight days. You're charming company.
details: Returning is the true compliment. +{xp} XP
Three evenings in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week. That's commitment.
Seven days running. Applause.
details: A week without a missed evening. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You simply don't quit.
Fourteen days straight. Remarkable.
details: Two weeks, not one skipped. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. Truly, thank you.
A month of turning up. That means something.
details: A full month at the table. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You back the long odds.
Five long shots. Refreshingly contrary.
Fifteen underdogs. You choose the hard bets deliberately.
Fifteen. You never follow the crowd's lead.
details: Fifteen votes on the long odds. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Utterly unreadable.
Thirty. The long shot is your signature.
details: Thirty votes for the one trailing. +{xp} XP

messages: First to arrive five times. Admirably prompt.
Five times you beat everyone to the door.
details: You arrive before the guests. +{xp} XP
Five votes before the guests arrived. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches with you out front. A fine habit.
First through the doors, time after time.
details: Ahead of the whole guest list. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You enjoy a tense table.
Another narrow one. Your composure beats mine.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps swaying the room.
You've tipped the room more than once.
You stood by the underdog five times. Stubborn. Splendid.
You never abandon a side that's trailing. Respect.
details: Faith in a late rally. +{xp} XP
Five rallies you stood behind. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Someone has a favourite.
That one again? It must be exquisite.
details: You know your own mind. +{xp} XP
One selection, three times over. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes, one moment. Now that's devotion.
You're not moving off that one. Admirable.
details: One favourite, five votes cast. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes on the same moment. A true obsession.
Ten times, same pick. I'd never judge. Out loud.
details: Ten on a lone selection. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're staying for dessert.
Round two and you're still seated. Lovely.
details: Stay for the next course. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. Deep into the evening now.
Deep in the bracket. The stakes rise from here.
details: A long way from the first toast. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw the whole evening through.
All the way. You didn't slip out early.
details: First toast to the last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You inspect every table.
Ten different matches. Curious. Lovely.
Twenty-five matches. You've toured the whole establishment.
Twenty-five. Not a booth unvisited.
Fifty matches. That isn't browsing, that's a vocation.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the architects.
Five in one sitting. A fine pace.
Five back to back. Carry on.
Ten in one go. Do take a breath.
Ten in a single sitting. Remarkable stamina.
Voting at this hour? The best company keeps late hours.
The small hours. Devotion, or the champagne's keeping you up.
details: The small hours suit you. +{xp} XP

messages: You told people. Many thanks.
Five shares. More guests, more votes.
details: Thank you for the introductions. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You're practically family.
Fifteen. You keep bringing guests. Delightful.
You were here before the doors opened. Founding member, for good.
One of the first thousand. Nobody takes that from you.
details: That honour's yours for good. +{xp} XP
Nobody can strip that from you. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Earned, and worn well.
Promoted. Do try to stay humble.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Beautifully done.
Another one on the shelf: {name}.
{rank}. Hard-earned.
You put in the effort and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. It runs in the family, I'm afraid.
Ten long shots. Nothing frightens you.
details: Long shots are your trade. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cait. Your nerves are exquisite.
Ten tight finishes. She'd be proud. I'll neither confirm nor deny my own pride.
Seven days with Cait. Her poise is rubbing off.
A week and not one slip. Well done.
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Beautifully.
A tied match and you made the decisive call. Respect.
details: The vote that swayed the room. +{xp} XP

messages: Splendid choice. I've got your back.
Vi's at your table now. Do keep up.

upcoming: Not open yet. The doors are still closed.
Voting hasn't started. I'll let you know when we open.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Study both, then decide.
Look at them both before you choose. No guessing.
I won't tell you which. Your table.
Take a moment. Then place your vote.
Go with your taste. It rarely misleads.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Open the bidding.
Blank so far. Sign the guest book first.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Take a seat.
The doors are closing. Decide now.
closing-3h: Time's short. Vote before the lights dim.
closing-final: Minutes remain. Make your move, darling.
voted-early: You voted early, with barely anyone in. Bold.
Barely a vote cast and you chose. Decisive. I approve.
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Lovely. Not settled yet.
A lead's a lead. Do keep watching.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. I'm gripping my glass.
Razor margin. One more vote flips it. Tell someone.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs allies.
voted-tied: Dead level. Nobody holds the edge.
A perfect tie. Maddening. Rather delightful.
voted-behind: You're behind. That doesn't make you mistaken.
{pick} is trailing. An underdog. My preferred kind.
They're ahead. You're not mistaken, merely outnumbered.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Send invitations.
Most chose otherwise. That proves nothing.
closed-won: {pick} went through. You read the room well.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. A pity. Compose yourself.
It didn't make it. It happens. Next one.
{pick} is out. My condolences. It was a fine choice.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side conceded an inch.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this one. More to come.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, do attend.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Everyone has an opening move.
That's your first. They grow easier.
You're at the table now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days in a row. I see you returning.
You keep returning. I find that charming.
underdog: You backed the one nobody else dared. Noted.
A difficult choice. A fine one.
early: Early. You arrived before the guests.
Few votes so far. Yours carries weight.
First through the door. Nicely done.
close: That vote tilted the room. It's tight.
Razor thin. One more voice tips it.
Close one. Your vote counts for a great deal.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't finished. Bring people.
Not winning yet. Which means the evening isn't over.
Behind, not beaten. A crucial difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Margins shift.
A good pick, by the look of it.
default: Noted. I won't dissuade you. For the moment.
Vote recorded. Plenty more to sample.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no positions taken. Begin with the one you feel strongest about.
Everything's open. Choose. I won't hurry you.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Perhaps a little.
live-some: {voted} done, {unvoted} to go. Keep the momentum.
A good start. The rest won't decide themselves.
live-few: Almost done. Don't lose your poise now.
live-one: The final one. Don't leave it hanging.
One match between you and a clean slate.
live-closing: Some of these conclude in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your word.
The clock is ticking. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} remaining.
Nearly out of time. Do vote.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Splendid. Do inspect the bracket.
Nothing left for you here. Return when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live at the moment. It'll open again. Study the bracket meanwhile.
No matches open. Even I'm a touch bored.
brackets-groups: Groups first. The top two from each advance. The rest are shown out.
Everyone is seated in a group. Not everyone leaves with their dignity.
Watch the tables. They shift quickly.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts soon. The top two from each group advance.
No knockout yet. The groups must conclude first.
Patience. The knockout assembles itself once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you're escorted out.
Every match carries more weight now. Choose well.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. One misstep and you're shown the door.
Follow the bracket. The knot tightens each round.
Every line here is a negotiation someone voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup concluded. Thank you for attending.
It's over. A fine run. I shall miss it.
A champion is crowned. Worth the evening.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. No names have been drawn.
Empty. The seating hasn't been drawn. Soon.
Nothing to see yet. Do return later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote decides it. Choose.
Two edits, one choice: {a} against {b}. Place your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Join me and share your view.
voted: I voted {pick} over {other}. What would you choose?
{pick} gets my vote over {other}. Do try to persuade me otherwise.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Think I'm mistaken?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more voices.
I arrived early for {pick} over {other}. Add your voice.
{pick} versus {other}, scarcely a vote yet. Yours would be noticed.
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level. One vote seals it.
A tie, {pick} against {other}. Who dares tip the scale?
{pick} and {other} are joined at the hip. Your vote can part them.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every voice matters now.
Merely {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Place yours.
{pick} against {other}, {voteDiff} apart. It could fall either way.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few votes turn the table.
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} can still win. Lend a hand.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It needs allies.
Down {voteDiff} to {other}. {pick} deserves a finer evening. Vote.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, narrowly. Help it keep the table.
{pct}% for {pick} over {other}. A slender lead. For now.
dominating: {pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Do come and see why.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Add your voice.
